specs.Hard Disk Type: Mechanical Hard Disk, Portable Storage Device

features: 500GB everyday storage: Add space for photos, videos, documents and backup copies with a portable mechanical hard drive for home, study and office use.
USB 3.0 performance: Transfer speeds up to 145 MB/s. Actual performance varies by device, USB port, cable, file size and file type.
Cable and OTG adapter included: Connect using the supplied accessories. Mobile use requires USB OTG support, a compatible file system and sufficient power; compatibility varies by device.
Computer compatibility: Use with compatible Windows, macOS and Linux systems. Some devices may require formatting; back up existing files before formatting because it erases data.
Compact portable design: Carry additional storage between home and office in a slim black enclosure. Keep the drive stable during use and safely eject it before disconnecting.
Box contents and warranty: Includes a 500GB external hard drive, USB cable, OTG adapter and user manual, with a 1-year warranty. Available storage varies with formatting and the operating system.
